dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 14, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Cubs Snap Streak, Cardinals Fall 3-0**

The Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-0, behind Seiya Suzuki's 2-for-4 day, including his 21st home run of the season. Suzuki's 3-RBI performance was the highlight of the game, as the Cubs pitching staff shut out the Cardinals. Matthew Liberatore took the loss for St. Louis, allowing 2 earned runs over 5.1 innings.

**Reds Edge Marlins in Low-Scoring Affair**

The Cincinnati Reds edged the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Eugenio Suárez providing the offense with a double in the 8th inning. Chase Burns pitched a complete game shutout for the Reds, striking out 8 and walking none. Sandy Alcantara took the loss for the Marlins, allowing 1 run on 4 hits over 7 innings.

**Pirates Bounce Back, Red Sox Fall 8-4**

The Pittsburgh Pirates bounced back with an 8-4 win over the Boston Red Sox, behind a 3-for-4 performance from Rafael Flores Jr. Flores Jr. hit his 2nd home run of the season, and multiple Pirates contributors had strong games. Bubba Chandler earned the win for the Pirates, allowing 2 earned runs over 5 innings.

**White Sox Outlast Tigers 9-5**

The Chicago White Sox outlasted the Detroit Tigers 9-5, behind Miguel Vargas' 4-for-5 day, including 2 home runs and 3 RBIs. Vargas' 27th home run of the season was the highlight of the game, as the White Sox pitching staff held off the Tigers. José Urquidy earned the win for the White Sox, allowing 5 earned runs over 6 innings.

**Mets Take Down Nationals 4-1**

The New York Mets took down the Washington Nationals 4-1, behind Francisco Lindor's 1-for-3 day, including a home run. Lindor's 1 RBI was the highlight of the game, as the Mets pitching staff held off the Nationals. Jonathan Pintaro earned the win for the Mets, allowing 1 earned run over 5 innings.

**Padres Rally Past Guardians 7-5**

The San Diego Padres rallied past the Cleveland Guardians 7-5, behind Nathaniel Lowe's 3-for-4 day, including a home run. Lowe's 2 RBIs were the highlight of the game, as the Padres pitching staff held off the Guardians. Michael King earned the win for the Padres, allowing 5 earned runs over 7 innings.

**Orioles Edge Rays 6-5**

The Baltimore Orioles edged the Tampa Bay Rays 6-5, behind Gunnar Henderson's 4-for-4 day, including a home run. Henderson's 2 RBIs were the highlight of the game, as the Orioles pitching staff held off the Rays. Josh Walker earned the win for the Orioles, allowing 5 earned runs over 6 innings.

**Diamondbacks Blank Braves 2-0**

The Arizona Diamondbacks blanked the Atlanta Braves 2-0, behind Chris Sale's 6 innings of 1-run ball. Tim Tawa's home run was the highlight of the game, as the Diamondbacks pitching staff held off the Braves. Brandon Pfaadt earned the win for the Diamondbacks, allowing 1 earned run over 6 innings.

**Blue Jays Take Down Yankees 3-1**

The Toronto Blue Jays took down the New York Yankees 3-1, behind Alejandro Kirk's 2-for-3 day, including a home run. Kirk's 2 RBIs were the highlight of the game, as the Blue Jays pitching staff held off the Yankees. Shane Bieber earned the win for the Blue Jays, allowing 1 earned run over 6 innings.

**Astros Outlast Mariners 10-7**

The Houston Astros outlasted the Seattle Mariners 10-7, behind Christian Walker's 2-for-5 day, including a home run. Walker's 3 RBIs were the highlight of the game, as the Astros pitching staff held off the Mariners. Enyel De Los Santos earned the win for the Astros, allowing 2 earned runs over 5 innings.

**Royals Edge Angels 7-6**

The Kansas City Royals edged the Los Angeles Angels 7-6, behind Jac Caglianone's 3-for-4 day, including a home run. Caglianone's 5 RBIs were the highlight of the game, as the Royals pitching staff held off the Angels. Alex Lange earned the win for the Royals, allowing 6 earned runs over 6 innings.

**Athletics Rout Rangers 8-3**

The Oakland Athletics routed the Texas Rangers 8-3, behind Jeff McNeil's 4-for-5 day, including a home run. McNeil's 3 RBIs were the highlight of the game, as the Athletics pitching staff held off the Rangers. Luis Medina earned the win for the Athletics, allowing 3 earned runs over 2 innings.

**Dodgers Take Down Brewers 3-1**

The Los Angeles Dodgers took down the Milwaukee Brewers 3-1, behind Yoshinobu Yamamoto's 6 innings of 1-run ball. Andy Pages' home run was the highlight of the game, as the Dodgers pitching staff held off the Brewers. Edwin Díaz earned the save for the Dodgers, allowing 1 earned run over 1 inning.

**Rockies Outlast Giants 5-2**

The Colorado Rockies outlasted the San Francisco Giants 5-2, behind Zac Veen's home run. Veen's 2 RBIs were the highlight of the game, as the Rockies pitching staff held off the Giants. Kyle Freeland earned the win for the Rockies, allowing 2 earned runs over 7 innings.
